notes: MXB Race Day Live v0.5.6: corrective stability release built from the stable v0.5.4 extension/hot-update base. The v0.5.5 DWM/game-mirror path is completely removed so Garage cannot launch MX Bikes, cannot create a black mirror surface, and cannot consume resources in the background. The real two-way MX Bikes profile/content sync, native Bike/Head/Torso/Legs selection workflow, race loadout capture/apply, and stay-open hot updater remain. The taskbar path now extracts the exact desktop shortcut icon into a concrete multi-size assets/mxb_race_day_live.ico, applies that file directly through Tk + WM_SETICON/class icons, keeps one permanent AppUserModelID, migrates the shortcut to a dedicated MXB Race Day Live.exe launcher, and refreshes Explorer's icon cache.
